identity.reasoning: AI-assisted provisional interpretation: Red represents Vi's direct, proactive and commitment-heavy access pattern through Vault Breaker and Cease and Desist. Black is conditional: committing onto a chosen target can create power at the cost of position and requires the draft to supply follow-up or a survivable exit. This profile does not mean every Vi draft must snowball, and it does not establish automatic counters or a win probability.
